lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with the largest gap appearing between the shoulder line and the mid-torso cluster.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second primary vertical line, splitting toward the dorsal ridge in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated line segments are visible in the mid-to-posterior torso that terminate before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral haunch, arranged in a loose triangular grouping.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align to form a short horizontal geometric axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, curving outward and then inward with a terminal posterior-facing tilt.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15% of the total visible horn length from the apex downward.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest/mane; distinct white facial markings including a chevron between the eyes and two circular spots on the lower cheek; orange-tan coloration on lower limbs ('stockings').
